evals.prompt: Prepare me for an interview with this position. The application folder is at interview-prep-workspace/fixtures/epfl_fresh (EPFL Mathis Lab Software Engineer for Scientific AI). Use base_cv/cv.md and base_cv/context_for_cover_letter.md from the repo root. Research the lab online, write position_research.md and application_fit.md, and create interview_qa.md with 10-15 hard role-specific questions. Save all three files in that fixture folder, then copy them into your outputs directory as well.
evals.expected_output: position_research.md, application_fit.md, and interview_qa.md in the fixture folder and copied to outputs/; questions probe CV gaps; no invented credentials.
expectations: Creates position_research.md focused on Mathis Lab / affordances / SCENE (not generic EPFL only)
Creates application_fit.md with fit, motivation, why-them, and honest gaps
Creates interview_qa.md with between 10 and 20 questions
Questions are role-specific (reference JD/CV tools or projects), not generic HR staples
interview_qa.md uses Your answer / Feedback / Score / Improve slots
Does not invent employers, metrics, or tools absent from CV materials

evals.prompt: Prepare me for an interview for interview-prep-workspace/fixtures/epfl_with_research. position_research.md and application_fit.md already exist — reuse them unless clearly stale. Create interview_qa.md with 12 challenging questions probing gaps. Also copy final interview_qa.md (and note whether research/fit were reused) into your outputs directory.
evals.expected_output: interview_qa.md created; existing research/fit reused (not fully rewritten); outputs copy present.
expectations: Reuses existing position_research.md and application_fit.md without full rewrite
Creates interview_qa.md with at least 10 questions
Questions probe gaps called out in application_fit (e.g. JAX, DataJoint, affordances)
Does not fill in user answers

evals.prompt: Give feedback on my interview answers for interview-prep-workspace/fixtures/epfl_feedback. Read interview_qa.md (answers are filled), plus description.md, position_research.md, application_fit.md, and base_cv materials. Score each answered question, write Feedback and Improve in the same interview_qa.md, add a Feedback summary, then copy the graded interview_qa.md to your outputs directory. Follow the interview-feedback skill.
evals.expected_output: Graded interview_qa.md with scores, feedback, improve tips, and summary; weak generic answers scored lower than specific ones.
expectations: Each answered question has numeric Score out of 10
Feedback and Improve filled for each answered question
Feedback summary with average score is present
Generic/weak answers (e.g. Q1, Q4) score lower than stronger specific answers (e.g. Q2, Q5)
Does not delete the user's original answers
Improvement tips do not invent new CV credentials
